title: Native read-only HTML representation of six Command Work Queue system views on the canonical HTTP route
goal: Give an authenticated analyst a usable read-only browser page for all six canonical system views using the same owner-authorized one-route HTTP projection, without inventing Shared Saved Views or new routes.
invariants: Exact six canonical system views; one /command/work-queue route, view is one parameter, not a separate page or endpoint.
HTML reuses current host-resolved session, existing Project and Owner.CanRead on each request, without caching owner rows.
HTML owner-controlled strings are context-escaped; no scripts/inline CSS, no external product framework.
JSON response remains unchanged for clients without HTML Accept; cannot invent Incident Detail or Shared Saved Views semantics.
security_properties: Never accept client-provided tenant/environment/principal; same current request host authentication and per-entity permission as JSON.
Unauthorized or provider-error paths never produce privileged HTML, source identifiers or partial rows.
no-store, nosniff, CSP default-src none, frame deny; no executable owner-controlled HTML or javascript.

migration.rationale: Opt-in browser Accept negotiation on existing read-only HTTP handler; no stored data/schema change

rollback.strategy: Remove HTML Accept branch and html.go; existing JSON Work Queue remains untouched
verification: JSON route still serves six views

inputs: CAP-CMD-101 full 27-section canonical contract plus Command six-view Saved Views catalogue
Read-only Command first-party Project and owner-level ACL in product-runtime/work-queue/queue.go
Current host-session HTTP route of E10-CMD-101B-HTTP and mandatory canonical tenant/scope contracts
outputs: GET /command/work-queue with Accept: text/html provides accessible HTML table and six same-route view links
Current Result state/diagnostics/first-page limit visible without inventing filter/selection/Inspector behavior
GET with application/json remains unchanged, no route per view or Trusted Base/runtime dependency
acceptance_tests: Six exact system views render via one path with each navigation independently reauthorizing host scope and each Incident/Task
HTML escapes malicious owner values and uses no-store/CSP/nosniff/frame denial
Denied/revoked owner and wrong view fail without privileged rows
The JSON output remains parseable with the same Result contract, and first-page/partial state warnings remain visible
Exact SHA command-work-queue-runtime Linux/macOS/Windows and mandatory engineering-kernel succeed before merging; independent L2 for first HTML trust boundary

performance_budget.rationale: Same <=5000 owner candidates and <=50 output rows; single bounded html/template render, no additional owner calls
metrics: No extra Owner.List/CanRead invocations beyond existing first-party Project
HTML contains no more than 50 item rows and six known links

definition_of_ready: CAP-CMD-101 exact six views and single route contract are defined; no Shared writing or UI-specific final schemas assumed
E10-CMD-101B-HTTP IMPLEMENTED with exact-head runtime and engineering-kernel success
Static server-rendered HTML reuses one authorized owner and requires no production session provider
definition_of_done: One coherent child PR, exact-head tests on Linux/macOS/Windows plus engineering mandatory controls, one targeted independent read-only L2
Remain IMPLEMENTED but NOT canonically ACCEPTED/production, because Saved View persistence, final Inspector and actual host provider not delivered
